method: Transcription of the upstream class test MetaboliteSpectralMatching_test.cpp: its two-compound library (makeLibrary), its parameters (makeParams: 1 Da precursor, 0.5 Da fragment, top3, merge_spectra false), its four CCS scenarios and its computeHyperScore section; plus values derived by hand from the source formula (dot product and ln(N!) of the class-test spectra, the exportMzTab_ cells with StringUtils::toStr(double) = to_chars fixed 15 digits trimmed and std::ostream %g precision 6) and native error cases. The upstream TOPP MetaboliteSpectralMatcher has no test at test-data 0cb15f2.
evidence_tier: Tier 3 (transcribed class-test literals) for spectral_match_ccs_fields, default_parameters, the four ccs_filtering_* tests and hyper_score_matches_class_test's positivity and empty-spectrum checks; tier 4 (independently derived from the source text) for exported_rows_follow_the_source, the exact hyperscore values, annotations, modes and error cases, and the factorial unit test.
